title: Inference on Panatang Makabayan
summary: An experiment in large language model inference. The Panatang Makabayan is cut after each of its words, and four language models are asked to finish it. A second set holds the pledge whole and changes the speaker: ten voices, from a friar of the 1880s to the country itself. Selected as a winning entry for Day 9 of the Santelmo Pambansang Hámon sa Pagtula 2026.

title: René
summary: A collection of digitally manipulated self-portraits parodying works by Magritte, each paired with a poem meditating on the act of editing the accompanying artwork. Originally written during my first year and slowly refined as I grew in college. Published in Heights Ateneo.

title: Mga Glitch sa Guniguni
summary: This is the portfolio that won me the Ateneo College Awards of the Arts in Poetry and the Mulry Award.
